prompt: White fixes the streetlamp before dark
title: Bright Streetlamp Light
irony: White races to fix the streetlamp before dark, but the light only returns when she stops fixing and holds Green close.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Evening paints the street gold as kids gather under the tall dark streetlamp while porch lights blink on.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green wants one more tag game under the streetlamp, recites bulb facts, corrects White, and clutches his book as shadows stretch.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black kicks his ball hard into the streetlamp, the bulb pops dark, and night slides down the street before dinner.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The kids stamp and chant together for lamp light as moths bump the dark glass.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: White climbs the ladder with her toolbox, twists wires fast, Green shouts book warnings, and the lamp flickers and dies again.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Jade dares to jiggle the pole, the spare bulb rolls downhill, Yellow calls the chase like a grand final, and Green freezes in the gloom.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The kids chant again for lamp light, stomping shadows back as the sky turns purple-black.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: White sits on the curb with the cold toolbox and admits fixing cannot chase the shivers away.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: White opens her arms to Green, chooses a hug first, then small hands join on one wire.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The lamp buzzes warm gold as the kids chant and White sings the turned line holding Green close.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Lamp light pools gold on the sidewalk as kids play soft tag and White watches hand in hand.
